title: The matcher carries a distance budget
hook: The matcher carries a distance budget.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Track edit-budget states while reading a text so approximate matches remain automaton transitions.

misconception: An automaton can recognize only exact character matches.
objective: Track edit-budget states while reading a text so approximate matches remain automaton transitions.

claims.text: Reading each character advances all edit-prefix states together. Substitution, insertion and deletion transitions update the row; only a final-pattern state within the budget accepts the whole input.
